subtitle: A private offline workspace for your notes.
releaseNotes: v0.3.0: HTML live preview — notes containing HTML (full documents or fragments) are now detected automatically and rendered side-by-side with markdown, isolated in a sandboxed preview iframe so scripts can't touch the app. A mode button in the preview header lets you pin Auto, Markdown, or HTML per note; the editor switches to HTML syntax highlighting for HTML notes, and exporting an HTML note as .html emits its rendered document.
